Opened by warehouse-etl-ken on 2026-10-20

Our Python loader reads the first column of every Ledgerline CSV as `\ufeffDate`
instead of `Date`. A hex viewer shows the bytes EF BB BF at the start of the
file. Is that on purpose

args.title: Explain UTF-8 BOM default in CSV exports
args.body:
File: src/export/csv.ts

The export functionality correctly includes the UTF-8 BOM by default, which is documented to help spreadsheet apps detect UTF-8 encoding when opening CSV files directly.

label: question
file: src/export/csv.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

src/export/csv.ts defines bom = true by default with BOM = "\ufeff", explicitly documented as "Spreadsheet apps use the byte order mark to detect UTF-8 when a CSV is opened directly."
